description: This file defines schemas, data structures, and functions for generating and managing agent flow nodes and edges in a workflow system. It includes methods for creating nodes, updating edges, selecting tools, and handling dynamic input/output configurations.

methods.name: generateAgentflowv2
methods.description: Main function to generate agent flow nodes and edges based on configuration, question, and options.

methods.name: updateEdges
methods.description: Updates edges by filtering, assigning colors, labels, and handling special cases like multi-output and human input edges.

methods.name: generateSelectedTools
methods.description: Selects tools for nodes based on prompts and updates node input data accordingly.

methods.name: _generateSelectedTools
methods.description: Internal function to invoke language model to get list of tools based on prompt and question.

methods.name: generateNodesEdges
methods.description: Generates nodes and edges data structures by invoking a language model with a schema and question.

methods.name: generateNodesData
methods.description: Processes raw nodes and edges data, initializing node data and setting node types.

methods.name: initNode
methods.description: Initializes node data, including inputs, outputs, anchors, and IDs.

methods.name: initializeDefaultNodeData
methods.description: Creates default input values for node parameters.

methods.name: createAgentFlowOutputs
methods.description: Creates output anchors for a node based on its data.

methods.name: initializeOutputAnchors
methods.description: Initializes output anchors for a node.

methods.name: _showHideOperation
methods.description: Handles show/hide logic for input parameters based on conditions.

methods.name: showHideInputs
methods.description: Controls visibility of input parameters and anchors based on show/hide rules.

methods.name: showHideInputParams
methods.description: Returns input parameters with visibility set according to rules.

methods.name: showHideInputAnchors
methods.description: Returns input anchors with visibility set according to rules.
